title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
desc: A single mother inherits a farmhouse and uncovers her family's connection to the legendary Ghostbusters, revealing a supernatural legacy.

title: The Unholy
desc: The Unholy is a supernatural horror about a deaf girl who, after a visit from a spirit she believes to be the Virgin Mary, suddenly speaks and heals others, but dark, sinister forces are at play.

desc: Miami detectives, defying protocol, investigate their captain's murder, uncovering a dangerous conspiracy of corruption and cartel involvement, seeking justice and vindication.

title: Anaconda
desc: A documentary crew travelling through the Amazon picks up a stranded man whose hobby is to capture the giant Anaconda snake.

title: Ghost Rider
desc: Stunt biker Johnny is the devil's bounty hunter by night. Can he redeem his soul by fighting Blackheart, the devil's wayward son?

title: Gran Turismo
desc: An underdog gamer, an ex-racer, and an idealistic executive risk everything to transition from virtual gaming to real-world racing and take on the most elite motorsport competition on Earth.

title: Life
desc: A team of scientists aboard the International Space Station finds a rapidly evolving life form that caused extinction on Mars, and now threatens the crew and all life on Earth.

title: Hotel Transylvania 2

title: Vertical Limit
desc: Peter Garrett, finds himself in a challenging position when his sister and her team get trapped in a icy cave atop the world's 2nd highest mountain, K2.

desc: Glimpses of the events that exorcist father Gabriele Amorth's experiences while assisting a possessed child and revealing a conspiracy that has been kept secret within the Vatican for years.

desc: Paranormal enthusiasts Abby, Erin, Jillian and Patty set out to capture ghosts when they realise that someone is attempting to cause an apocalypse by summoning ghosts in the city of New York.
